s1.syndrome_frame: A mass in the nasal cavity with a history of growth and bleeding, characterized by an exophytic and verrucous appearance
salient_findings: A 1-cm, nontender, exophytic, verrucous, skin-colored plaque on the right nasal vestibule
Papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium on histologic examination
key_facts: The patient is a man in his 30s
The mass has been growing for about 1 year
The lesion bleeds with minimal trauma
The patient does not smoke
The patient denies any medical history of chronic rhinosinusitis
The mass does not obstruct breathing
The plaque is 1-cm in size and located on the right nasal vestibule
Histologic examination shows papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores
The epithelium is nonkeratinizing squamous
Mucin-containing goblet cells are present on higher magnification histology
There is no cytologic atypia or atypical mitotic figures

differentials: Papillary Squamous Cell Carcinoma with spindle cell features
per_call: Papillary Squamous Cell Carcinoma with spindle cell features

shortlist.label: Inverted Papilloma
shortlist.why_kept: Histologic examination shows papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores, consistent with inverted papilloma

shortlist.label: Schneiderian Papilloma
shortlist.why_kept: Papillary fronds and nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium are characteristic of Schneiderian papilloma

shortlist.label: Verrucous Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Exophytic and verrucous appearance of the plaque, along with mucin-containing goblet cells, are consistent with verrucous carcinoma

shortlist.label: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium and presence of mucin-containing goblet cells could be seen in squamous cell carcinoma

shortlist.label: Nasoethmoidal Papilloma
shortlist.why_kept: Location on the right nasal vestibule and histologic features are consistent with nasoethmoidal papilloma

raw.rationale: The presence of papillary fronds with slender fibrovascular cores lined by nonkeratinizing squamous epithelium and mucin-containing goblet cells, without cytologic atypia or atypical mitotic figures, is characteristic of inverted papilloma.

rejected.label: Verrucous Carcinoma
rejected.why: Verrucous carcinoma typically shows keratinizing squamous epithelium, which is not present in this case.

rejected.label: Squamous Cell Carcinoma
rejected.why: Squamous cell carcinoma typically shows cytologic atypia and atypical mitotic figures, which are not present in this case.

rejected.label: Schneiderian Papilloma
rejected.why: Schneiderian papilloma is a broader category that includes inverted papilloma, but the specific histologic features described are more characteristic of inverted papilloma.

rejected.label: Nasoethmoidal Papilloma
rejected.why: Nasoethmoidal papilloma is not a commonly recognized term, and the histologic features described are more consistent with inverted papilloma.
